entities.name: Philip IV of Macedon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philip IV was briefly king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedonia in 297 BC. He belonged to the Antipatrid dynasty and was the son of Thessalonike, daughter of Philip II, and Cassander, king of Macedonia.
